card.title: PETLYAKOV PE-2
card.flavorText: The Petlyakov Pe-2 was a Soviet light bomber used in WWII. Although it was mainly used as a ground attack aircraft, it was also successful in its roles as a heavy fighter, reconnaissance and night fighter. The Pe-2 was fast, maneuverable and proved itself as a very capable frontline bomber and was used in all major Soviet fronts, both against the Axis in Europe and against Japanese forces in Manchuria. In total 11,427 Pe-2 aircraft were built in WWII.
